moodys.citation_text: Griffin-Spalding County Hospital Authority, GA -- Moody's assigns A2 rating to Wellstar Health System's (GA) Ser. 2022A; outlook changed to positive.

sp.citation_text: Wellstar Health System Inc., GA Series 2023A Bond — S&P maintained A+ rating; consistent with 2025 upgrade context noting Augusta bonds upgraded to A+.

fitch.citation_text: No Fitch rating found for Wellstar Health in trade press; not actively rated by Fitch.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Wellstar-Augusta merger completed; S&P upgraded former Augusta system bonds from B- to A+ to reflect Wellstar's credit profile
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Merger with Augusta University Health effective August 30, 2023; combined entity Wellstar MCG Health
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: S&P upgraded bonds from the former Augusta system from 'B-' to 'A+' following the takeover, reflecting Wellstar's credit profile.
rating_actions_in_window.verification_note: This is an upgrade for the former Augusta bonds, not a system-level rating change for Wellstar.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Moody's affirmed Wellstar's existing A2 revenue ratings; investment-grade credit rating without change
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Continued strong market position in Georgia
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Moody's affirmed Wellstar's existing A2 revenue ratings in January 2022, and on March 5 issued a credit rating on WellStar that affirmed without change WellStar's investment-grade credit rating.

moodys.citation_text: Moody's upgrade to A1 occurred during window (per Becker's headline 'Moody's upgrades Wellstar's credit rating'); subsequent S&P 2025 coverage notes A+ rating.
moodys.verification_note: Exact date of Moody's upgrade not captured precisely; confidence MEDIUM.

sp.citation_text: Wellstar Health System Inc., Georgia; Joint Criteria - 2025/04/03 - S&P Global Ratings' Credit Research. A+ rating maintained.
sp.verification_note: April 3, 2025 is just after window_end (2025-03-31), but rating maintained through end-of-window.

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's upgraded Wellstar's credit rating (per Becker's headline) during the window — likely from A2 to A1. S&P A+ maintained. Wellstar absorbed Augusta University Health (Aug 2023) and former Augusta bonds were upgraded multiple notches to A+. Per schema, UPGRADE = at least one notch upgrade by any agency, no offsetting downgrade.

primary_sources_obtained: Becker's 'Moody's upgrades Wellstar's credit rating' headline
